combo_label: In the Bathroom × World Landmarks & Travel × Beatrix Potter

entries.clue: Uttar Pradesh city on the Yamuna, home to a marble mausoleum
Whiskered attic ruffian who rolled a kitten in dough for a roly-poly pudding
Rubber-cupped rescuer of hopelessly blocked drains
Rubbery raincoat, mercifully foul-tasting to a greedy fish
Waxed string for the gaps a brush cannot reach
Tool-filled hut where a hunted rabbit leapt into a watering can
Hot white cloud that fogs the mirror and beads the tiles
Bushy-tailed red like Twinkleberry, paying Old Brown tribute in minnows
Impertinent red who pelted Old Brown with riddles and paid with his tail
Standing storm you step into before work
Triumphal span in Paris or Rome, or the curve of a raised eyebrow
Coral ring marking where a volcanic island sank
All-inclusive haven whose guests rarely leave the grounds
Swirling exit where the bathwater finally escapes
